evidence.title: NICE social anxiety disorder guideline
evidence.claim_scope: Supports structured CBT mechanisms including behavioral experiments and work with safety-seeking behaviors in social anxiety treatment.
evidence.does_not_establish: Does not validate each CBT Cards exercise as a treatment, nor show that reducing genuine safety measures is appropriate.

evidence.title: NHS thought record
evidence.claim_scope: Supports separating situations, thoughts and evidence, then considering a more balanced or neutral view.
evidence.does_not_establish: Does not prove a feared interpretation false and is not a diagnostic instrument.

evidence.title: NHS problem solving
evidence.claim_scope: Supports distinguishing practical problems that can be acted on from concerns that do not currently have a practical solution.
evidence.does_not_establish: Does not justify dismissing concrete risk, urgent problems, or concerns that need professional input.

evidence.title: NHS tackling your worries
evidence.claim_scope: Supports a worry-tree distinction and setting aside worry for a planned review period.
evidence.does_not_establish: Does not show that all worry is unproductive or that postponement is suitable during genuine urgent risk.

evidence.title: NHS facing your fears
evidence.claim_scope: Supports gradual, manageable approach to feared situations rather than trying to remove all fear at once.
evidence.does_not_establish: Does not support approaching genuinely dangerous situations or overriding protective boundaries.

evidence.title: Centre for Clinical Interventions — Perfectionism resources
evidence.claim_scope: Provides CBT-oriented psychoeducation and exercises for unhelpful perfectionism, rigid standards and self-evaluation.
evidence.does_not_establish: Does not imply that high standards are inherently unhealthy or that professional requirements should be relaxed.

evidence.title: CBT Cards low-risk editorial synthesis
evidence.claim_scope: Allows a small reflection format when it transparently recombines reviewed CBT mechanisms without claiming that the exact card format has independent efficacy evidence.
evidence.does_not_establish: Does not establish clinical efficacy, suitability for an individual, or equivalence to therapist-delivered CBT.
